creator.description:
A Cornell Tech research project: labels providing context about accounts you interact with. Public data may be used for research.

If you subscribe, we’d appreciate a like – it helps support the project.

stech.bluesky.labeler@gmail.com
Icon:Flaticon

locales.description: In a 24 hour period, account both unfollowed at least 25% as many accounts as it newly followed, and unfollowed at least 500 other accounts.
locales.name: Unfollowed 500+ yesterday
